svg.title: Gaurav Sharma — DevOps and Web Development Learning Profile
svg.desc: A connected, dark engineering-console profile with introduction, current focus, learning stack, project queue, roadmap, workflow and contact information.

g.text: Learning to build, automate, ship and improve software — one practical lab at a time.
A learner with an engineering mindset
I’m pursuing BCA at Maharishi University of Information Technology and working toward a
career in DevOps. My starting point is web fundamentals and an IBM course certificate;
my next step is strengthening Linux, Git, delivery pipelines and cloud basics through practice.
Understand the basics. Build a small version. Automate it. Document what changed.
Status labels describe my learning plan, not professional-level proficiency.
Tools I know — and tools I’m learning
Honest skill map: coursework and beginner foundations are separated from the upcoming roadmap.
Small projects that turn learning into evidence
These are planned starter builds — I’ll replace the status as each project is completed and documented.

A practical route from fundamentals to delivery
Finish one small lab, write down what failed, then make the next iteration better.
Curious, consistent, and here to keep building.
I’m documenting the journey from beginner foundations to real, repeatable engineering projects.
